items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And old Sonny and them said, yes stay Marge.

ctx.x: So Zutty said, I think I'll, oh I'm going Marge, said you can stay up here if you want to. Well as I tell you, he accused me of every man in the world because he was so jealous. I couldn't understand what he was going to do. Letting me stay up there with all those guys and all and he's going to go downstairs and go to bed.

So I said, well I believe I'll go down, I stayed. And old Sonny and them said, yes stay Marge. And they were playing records and all. And so I said, I believe I'll go down. And I went down and I was half drunk too. And put the key in the door, and couldn't get the door opened. But I knocked on the door and came to the door.
And Johnny Hodges had pulled the sheet up over his head. He was in the bed. And I walked right over to the bed and I said, that's why you left me up
